name: OpenHealthConsent
title: OpenHealth Consent (HIE-CM pattern)
description: Signed, revocable consent artefact for cross-facility record sharing (HIE-CM pattern). NDPA 2023 baseline: consent is data — revocable and auditable, with a patient-facing receipt.

element.comment: active | inactive (revoked) — revocation takes effect at the consent manager immediately.
Who may access: facility (Location) or provider (Practitioner) from the registry.
The signed artefact (digital signature or captured consent receipt).
